what: An ambient instrument. ALIGN writes a whole 4-track piece in one of 13 moods, always in key; AUTO keeps it growing from your own pattern. SKY macros, a three-head SPACE TAPE echo with spring, and visions drawn from the music: cymatics, harmonograph, attractor and orrery.
author: Polaris Sound Lab
sounds: CC0: Versilian Studios VSCO-2 Community Edition and VCSL samples (piano, flute, sax, kept from Felucca); the ambient presets and the FM voice bank are own
